# The chronology

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

One patient's events in time order, for a post-incident review, ready to print or download.

## What is on the screen

1. Find a patient. Search by name or UMRN to build their chronology.
2. Patients on the board. Everyone with a record, A to Z by surname. Choose one to open their chronology.
3. Generated. When it was built. Synthetic demo data, not a clinical record.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.
